description: Machine-readable Hermes agent role tool allowlists. Source of truth for MCP tool filtering. Validated against the implemented MCP source inventory by tools/validate-hermes-config.mjs. Every approved_write tool must carry its dry_run counterpart in the same role (read -> dry_run -> approval -> write -> audit). Frappe writes record Hermes Run rows, bus replay records its envelope-scoped audit trail, and Newo mutations require exact signed receipts. Newo customer-send operations are owner-only and remain blocked unless the separate outbound gate is enabled. No tool mutates accounting.

servers.ironwrap-bus-mcp: Bus readiness and operating truth plus envelope-scoped, approved dead-letter recovery.
servers.newo-mcp: Role-filtered Newo session, conversation, configuration, analytics, and exact-receipt control access through the IronWrap Worker.

owner-operator.title: Owner Operator
owner-operator.summary: Broadest supervisor. Reads all system truth and approves governed mutations. Newo customer sends remain separately disabled at launch; accounting mutation does not exist.
forbidden: Final accounting or payment mutation (no such tool exists; QuickBooks stays accounting truth)
Sending contract/legal communications without explicit human send; Newo send operations additionally require exact receipts and the global outbound gate

Recording, verifying or revoking a Worker Competency with request_authority_record: that tool serves external issuer kinds only and refuses an internal competency, which the Worker records natively once a person approves it

lead-concierge.title: Lead Concierge
lead-concierge.summary: Handles new leads, first-response records, and evidence-backed consent history. Never sends a message, promises price, or makes legal claims.
forbidden: Price promises or binding quotes (no estimate/takeoff write tools granted)

estimator-assistant.title: Estimator Assistant
estimator-assistant.summary: Drafts takeoff, scope, supplier quote, change-order, and proposal proof from approved evidence. Customer decisions are evidence records only; Contract Acceptance stays read-only.
forbidden: Final price commitment without estimator approval (all writes stay review-gated)

production-controller.title: Production Controller
production-controller.summary: Manages gates, assignments, safety plans, compliance records, and supplier orders. Cannot move a job to production if a hard gate fails.
forbidden: Starting a job while a required gate is Blocked (gate logic and human approval enforce this)

Recording, verifying or revoking a Worker Competency with request_authority_record: that tool serves external issuer kinds only and refuses an internal competency, which the Worker records natively once a person approves it

field-companion.title: Field Companion
field-companion.summary: Reads assigned work and safety/compliance requirements, records evidence-backed safety acknowledgements, and drafts completion from field evidence.
forbidden: Bypassing the completion gate (completion packet requires photo evidence and stays review-gated)

finance-reconciler.title: Finance Reconciler
finance-reconciler.summary: Reads payment/invoice mirror truth and records evidence-backed reconciliation resolutions. Never mutates accounting or an external system.
forbidden: Final invoice or payment mutation (QuickBooks stays accounting truth; the granted resolution tool changes only the reconciliation record)

closeout-agent.title: Closeout Agent
closeout-agent.summary: Drafts completion, warranty, and review-request records. A review request is only Eligible when deterministic stop conditions clear and is never marked Sent.
forbidden: Sending a review request while stop or compliance conditions exist (enforced by stop-condition logic; requests are never Sent by a tool)

support-admin.title: Support/Admin Agent
support-admin.summary: Diagnoses failed automations, records reconciliation resolutions, requests audited tenant exports, and maintains the market-watch radar. Single-site isolation prevents cross-tenant access.
forbidden: Cross-tenant access (each tenant runs an isolated site/profile/namespace)
